_about: Places Ask may send a visitor. The model only writes an id in double brackets ([[jwt]]); the Worker and the page turn ids into links from this file. href is relative to the site root. about (60 characters max) goes into Ask's prompt. tests/ask-tools.test.mjs fails if an href points to a page or anchor that doesn't exist.
